d:
Track days are easy. The tarmac is smooth, the corners are predictable, and every motorcycle feels like a weapon. But real life doesn't happen on a track.
If you buy a supersport in India, chances are you’re going to commute on it. You’re going to ride it through broken roads, unscientific speed breakers, brutal afternoon heat, and bumper-to-bumper Monday morning chaos.
We brought the brand-new Yamaha R2 to Pune to answer one simple question: What happens when that ten-year-old dream of owning a fully faired superbike meets the harsh, unglamorous reality of the daily city grind?
